verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents native round-robin scheduling that automatically distributes meetings fairly across team members, with a choice between random selection or cycling for equal distribution, and per-member custom availability (docs-7, docs-19, docs-20, docs-21). However, there's no evidence of configurable weighting or priority-based load distribution (e.g., assigning different volume ratios to reps) — only binary random vs. equal-cycle modes. Missing for 10: weighted/priority-based distribution controls, capacity-based load balancing, and any admin reporting on fairness of distribution.
